verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents its own quota controls: a daily event quota with two overage options, 'capture every event' or 'rate limiting', where rate limiting can keep an error storm within the quota. It also documents control over which events count toward the quota, via discard rules (now enforced in the Android and iOS SDKs) and before-notify filtering. However, the evidence never shows quotas capped per project or an explicit spend limit or billing cap, so only the predictable-budget half of the story is supported. Missing for 10: per-project event quota caps, explicit spend limits or invoice caps, detail on how rate limiting behaves during overages, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
